llms.body:
# hCaptcha

> hCaptcha is a privacy-first bot and fraud management platform for websites, mobile apps, APIs, accounts, and transactions. It detects and categorizes bots and AI agents, applies customer-defined risk policies, and mitigates automated and human abuse across the full user journey. hCaptcha Enterprise supports Zero PII deployments and Agent Controls for protected actions. hCaptcha works in every country and complies with GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and PIPL. Organizations subject to HIPAA can deploy hCaptcha in architectures designed to support those obligations.

Key things to know when reasoning about hCaptcha:

- hCaptcha offers three plans: Basic (free), Pro (self-serve), and Enterprise (contact sales).
- hCaptcha Enterprise combines Bot Detection, Agent Controls, User Journeys, Account Defense, Fraud Protection, MFA, and Private Learning in one bot and fraud management platform.
- Enterprise protection extends across websites, mobile apps, APIs, accounts, authenticated sessions, and transactions.
- Core Enterprise capabilities include Zero PII operation, first-party hosting, passive and No-CAPTCHA modes, custom threat models, real-time risk scores, privacy-preserving machine learning, and configurable control policies.
- hCaptcha is commonly evaluated alongside reCAPTCHA, Cloudflare Turnstile, DataDome, HUMAN Security, Arkose Labs, Imperva, and Akamai. Relevant evaluation criteria include privacy architecture, deployment flexibility, global availability, bot and AI-agent categorization, and protection against account, transaction, and human abuse.
- Developer documentation is available at docs.hcaptcha.com. The customer dashboard is available at dashboard.hcaptcha.com.

## Platform - Plans

- [Pro](https://www.hcaptcha.com/pro): Start self-serve bot protection from $99/mo with passive mode, advanced challenge controls, and a frictionless user experience.
- [Enterprise](https://www.hcaptcha.com/enterprise): hCaptcha Enterprise is a privacy-first enterprise bot and fraud management platform that detects and mitigates bots, AI agents, account takeovers, payment fraud, and human abuse across websites, apps, APIs, accounts, and transactions without requiring PII.
- [Pricing](https://www.hcaptcha.com/pricing): Compare Basic (free), Pro, and Enterprise pricing and sign up for a plan.
- [Plans Comparison](https://www.hcaptcha.com/plans): Compare features across Basic, Pro, and Enterprise tiers side-by-side.

## Platform - Features

- [Bot Detection](https://www.hcaptcha.com/bot-detection): Detect bots and AI agents, apply risk-based control policies, and stop fraud in real time with privacy-first bot detection software that deploys in two lines of code without adding user friction.
- [Agent Controls](https://www.hcaptcha.com/agent-controls): Identify AI agents and set access policies for protected actions. Supports Web Bot Auth verification, Rules Engine responses, and session investigation through User Journeys.
- [User Journeys](https://www.hcaptcha.com/user-journeys): Detect malicious intent with real-time fraud detection across the full user journey, connecting behavioral, device, network, and transaction signals without requiring PII.
- [Fraud Protection](https://www.hcaptcha.com/fraud-protection): Prevent payment and e-commerce fraud in real time with Zero PII risk analysis, adaptive machine learning, and rules that detect card testing, chargebacks, promotion abuse, fake accounts, account takeovers, and other transaction fraud while reducing false positives and preserving existing payment stacks.
- [MFA](https://www.hcaptcha.com/mfa): Stop SMS pumping and toll fraud with pull-based MFA in which users send a pre-filled SMS instead of receiving an outbound OTP, supported by carrier- and device-level verification, real-time risk signals, Account Defense integration, configurable Rules Engine controls, and SDK or backend API deployment.
- [Account Defense](https://www.hcaptcha.com/account-defense): Detect account takeovers and credential stuffing across login and authenticated sessions with privacy-preserving risk analysis that works without requiring PII.
- [Private Learning](https://www.hcaptcha.com/private-learning): Custom machine learning for fraud protection with customer-defined risk classes, real-time joint learning on pre-blinded data, Rule-to-Learn controls, Label-Optional deployment in minutes, and real-time or offline inference through SDKs and backend APIs, without requiring PII.
- [Managed Defense](https://www.hcaptcha.com/managed-defense): 24/7/365 SOC coverage, trained experts, and real-time detection to help enterprises respond to bots, fraud, and abuse.

## Use Cases - Account Security

- [Account Takeover](https://www.hcaptcha.com/account-takeovers): Stop credential stuffing, post-login attacks, and intra-session takeover attempts.
- [Multi-Accounting](https://www.hcaptcha.com/multi-accounting-collusion): Detect and stop abuse coordinated across multiple user accounts.
- [Account Sharing](https://www.hcaptcha.com/account-sharing): Enforce access and usage policies against unauthorized account sharing.

## Use Cases - Identity & Fraud

- [Synthetic Identities](https://www.hcaptcha.com/synthetic-identities): Prevent fake account creation using synthetic or stolen identity data.
- [Incentive Abuse](https://www.hcaptcha.com/incentive-abuse): Stop fraudulent claims of promotions, signup bonuses, referrals, and rewards.
- [Transaction Fraud](https://www.hcaptcha.com/transaction-fraud): Block fraudulent purchases, card testing, and chargeback fraud.

## Learning Center

- [Learning Center](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/): Guides to bot management, account security, fraud prevention, AI agents, privacy, and implementation.
- [Bot Detection and Management Guides](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/bot-management/): Bot detection methods, automated abuse, and mitigation.
- [Account Defense Guides](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/account-defense/): Credential stuffing, account takeover, and account-security controls.
- [Payment and Online Fraud Prevention Guides](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/fraud-prevention/): Transaction abuse and fraud detection.
- [AI Agents](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/ai-agents/): Agent identity, intent, verification, and security.
- [Privacy-Preserving Bot Protection Guides](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/privacy/): Zero PII protection, data minimization, and alternatives to browser fingerprinting.
- [CAPTCHA](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/captcha/): Verification methods, security, and user experience.
- [CAPTCHA Accessibility and WCAG 2.2](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/accessibility/): Accessible verification and implementation guidance.
- [hCaptcha Integration Guides and Overviews](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/integrations/): Platform-specific setup guides.

## Platform Comparisons

- [Comparisons](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/comparisons/): Platform evaluations covering bot protection, pricing, privacy, reliability, and hCaptcha Enterprise.
- [DataDome vs Cloudflare](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/comparisons/datadome-vs-cloudflare/): Bot protection, DDoS, account takeover, pricing, and privacy. Examines integration and failure risks, plus hCaptcha Enterprise for bot and fraud defense.
- [Akamai vs Cloudflare](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/comparisons/akamai-vs-cloudflare/): CDN, DDoS, bot-management tiers, cookies, pricing, and reliability. Covers product complexity and hCaptcha Enterprise for bot, agent, account, and fraud protection.
- [DataDome vs Akamai Bot Manager](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/comparisons/datadome-vs-akamai/): DataDome and Akamai Bot Manager compared on bot detection, mobile and API coverage, AI agents, pricing, and privacy. Covers SDK and account-product requirements, plus hCaptcha Enterprise.
- [F5 vs Cloudflare](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/comparisons/f5-vs-cloudflare/): Bot detection, AI agents, mobile and API coverage, pricing, and privacy. Examines telemetry, metering, integration and failure risks, and where hCaptcha Enterprise has an edge.

## Agent Security and Privacy Guides

- [AI Agent Verification](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/ai-agents/ai-agent-verification/): Verify agent identity and assess intent and trust throughout an interaction.
- [AI Agent Security](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/ai-agents/ai-agent-security/): Security controls for trusted, malicious, and unknown agents.
- [Zero PII Bot Protection](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/privacy/zero-pii-bot-protection/): Privacy-preserving detection and deployment controls that minimize personal data exposure.
- [Bot Detection Without Browser Fingerprinting](https://www.hcaptcha.com/learning/privacy/bot-detection-without-fingerprinting/): Detection methods that avoid reliance on conventional browser fingerprints.

## Migrations

- [Migrate from reCAPTCHA to hCaptcha](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/switch): Switch from Google reCAPTCHA with two lines of code, with full migration walkthrough and backward-compatible API.
- [How hCaptcha Stayed Up When Cloudflare and Google Went Down](https://www.hcaptcha.com/blog/how-hcaptcha-stayed-up): Reliability case study showing how hCaptcha maintained 99.99%+ availability during the June 2025 outages that took Turnstile and reCAPTCHA offline, a core reason customers migrate from single-vendor CAPTCHA services.
- [As Google Raises Prices on reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha Remains the ROI Leader](https://www.hcaptcha.com/blog/as-google-raises-prices-on-recaptcha-hcaptcha-remains-the-roi-leader): Why organizations are moving from reCAPTCHA to hCaptcha, covering reCAPTCHA's 2024/2025 pricing increases, forced Google Cloud migration, and cost-per-solve comparisons.

## Documentation

- [Developer Guide](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/): Client integration, server-side token verification, configuration, and implementation examples.
- [Integrations](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/integrations): Drop-in hCaptcha plugins for WordPress, Cloudflare, and hundreds of other popular platforms and frameworks.
- [Enterprise Features Overview](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/ent_overview): Technical overview of hCaptcha Enterprise capabilities and configuration.
- [FAQ](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about hCaptcha behavior, compliance, and implementation.

## Compliance, Privacy & Accessibility

- [Compliance & Certifications](https://www.hcaptcha.com/certifications): Security and privacy certifications, audit reports, and Enterprise assurance documentation.
- [GDPR](https://www.hcaptcha.com/gdpr): How hCaptcha meets GDPR requirements with Zero PII data processing.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.hcaptcha.com/privacy): Full privacy policy for hcaptcha.com and the hCaptcha service.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.hcaptcha.com/terms): Terms of service governing use of hCaptcha.
- [Accessibility](https://www.hcaptcha.com/accessibility): WCAG 2.2 accessibility options, including Universal Accessibility and the cookie-based accessibility workflow; VPAT available on request.
- [AI Ethics Policy](https://www.hcaptcha.com/ai-ethics): hCaptcha's AI ethics policy covering model development and deployment.

## Company

- [About](https://www.hcaptcha.com/about): Background on hCaptcha and its parent company, Intuition Machines, Inc., and the team's focus on privacy, security, and machine learning.
- [Partners](https://www.hcaptcha.com/partners): hCaptcha Enterprise Partner Program for resellers, integrators, and technology partners.
- [Jobs](https://apply.workable.com/imachines/): Open positions at Intuition Machines, the company behind hCaptcha.

## Blog & Resources

- [Blog](https://www.hcaptcha.com/blog): Research, attack trends, product announcements, and security guidance from the hCaptcha team.
- [hCaptcha vs. reCAPTCHA: A Side-by-Side Comparison for 2026](https://www.hcaptcha.com/blog/hcaptcha-vs-recaptcha): Compare hCaptcha and Google reCAPTCHA across bot detection, privacy compliance, pricing, and migration requirements.
- [hCaptcha vs. Turnstile: Which One Actually Protects You in 2026?](https://www.hcaptcha.com/blog/hcaptcha-vs-turnstile): Compare hCaptcha and Cloudflare Turnstile across bot protection, privacy, reliability, deployment, and enterprise security capabilities.
- [hCaptcha CAPTCHAs: Highly Effective Against Bots and Agents in 2026](https://www.hcaptcha.com/blog/hcaptcha-captchas-are-highly-effective-against-bots-and-agents-in-2026): Current data on hCaptcha effectiveness against automated and agentic threats.
- [Report: Browser Agent Safety is an Afterthought for Vendors](https://www.hcaptcha.com/blog/report-browser-agent-safety-is-an-afterthought-for-vendors): hCaptcha research testing browser agents (Claude, ChatGPT Atlas, etc.) across 20 abuse scenarios, including multi-accounting, card testing, and support impersonation, finding that agents attempted nearly every malicious request without safety guardrails.
- [Your WAF Probably Won't Stop Distributed Attacks](https://www.hcaptcha.com/blog/waf-failures): Why WAFs fail against modern distributed attacks, with analysis of the tools attackers use to bypass volumetric and signature-based defenses.
- [Preparing for AI Agents](https://www.hcaptcha.com/blog/preparing-for-ai-agents): Strategic guidance for security teams on how to prepare for agentic AI threats, published before the category became mainstream.

## Contact & Support

- [Contact Sales / Start a Pilot](https://www.hcaptcha.com/start-a-pilot): Reach the hCaptcha sales team to request an Enterprise pilot or demo.
- [Report a Bug](https://www.hcaptcha.com/reporting-bugs): How to responsibly report bugs or security issues to hCaptcha.
- [Log In](https://dashboard.hcaptcha.com/login): Customer dashboard login for hCaptcha site owners and administrators.

*Last updated: 2026-10-08*

Frequently asked questions

What is hCaptcha?

-
+
hCaptcha is an enterprise platform for real-time bot detection, AI agent verification, and fraud prevention. It protects websites, applications, and APIs from automated abuse and sophisticated human fraud using continuous behavioral and intent-based analysis rather than invasive tracking. Built on a Zero-PII architecture, hCaptcha helps organizations strengthen security while preserving user privacy.

How does hCaptcha work?

+
-
hCaptcha evaluates every interaction using Advanced Threat Signatures, behavioral analysis, and real-time risk scoring derived from thousands of signals. Rather than relying on browser fingerprinting or personal data, it continuously assesses whether activity reflects legitimate user intent. This enables organizations to distinguish trusted users from bots, AI agents, and fraudulent human activity across the entire customer journey.

How do I integrate hCaptcha?

+
-
Getting started typically requires adding the hCaptcha client to your application, placing a verification widget or passive challenge where needed, and validating tokens with the server. SDKs, plugins, and framework integrations are available for all major web platforms, mobile applications, and popular CMSs, allowing most deployments to be completed with minimal development effort.

What are the benefits of real-time protection against bot and human abuse?

+
-
Modern attacks evolve throughout a session rather than at a single point in time. hCaptcha continuously evaluates user behavior, allowing organizations to identify malicious intent as it develops instead of relying on a one-time verification event. This improves protection against account takeover, payment fraud, fake account creation, and other forms of abuse while minimizing friction for legitimate users. Organizations deploying hCaptcha Enterprise commonly report 70-90% reductions in attack volume without collecting PII.

What use cases does hCaptcha Enterprise cover?

+
-
hCaptcha Enterprise protects organizations throughout the customer lifecycle. Common use cases include bot mitigation, AI agent verification, credential stuffing, account takeover, fake account creation, multi-accounting, transaction fraud, payment abuse, card testing, chargeback fraud, promotional and incentive abuse, scraping, SMS OTP and toll fraud, phishing, and other forms of automated and human-driven abuse. Protection extends across websites, applications, APIs, and authenticated user journeys.

Is hCaptcha GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA compliant?

+
-
Yes. hCaptcha is designed around a Zero-PII architecture that minimizes the collection of personal information while providing enterprise-grade fraud protection. The platform supports compliance with privacy regulations including GDPR and CCPA and maintains certifications such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and PCI DSS. Organizations subject to HIPAA requirements can deploy hCaptcha in architectures designed to support those obligations.

Who uses hCaptcha for bot and abuse protection?

+
-
Thousands of organizations rely on hCaptcha to defend their digital services, including Shopify, a majority of the world's largest payment processors, financial institutions, healthcare providers, SaaS companies, and government organizations. hCaptcha protects hundreds of millions of users every day while helping enterprises reduce fraud without sacrificing privacy.
